# Apple
> Apple’s official website for exploring, comparing, buying, and getting support for its devices, software, services, and developer platforms.

Apple.com is the primary entry point to Apple’s consumer ecosystem, with product overviews, online shopping, service information, and links into support and developer documentation. It spans hardware categories like iPhone, Mac, iPad, Watch, AirPods, and Vision Pro, plus entertainment services, accessories, and technical resources.

## Main Site
- [Apple](https://www.apple.com/): Apple homepage featuring products, services, promotions, and ecosystem highlights.
- [Store](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/store): Apple Online Store for purchasing devices, accessories, and services.
- [Support](https://support.apple.com/?cid=gn-ols-home-hp-tab): Official Apple Support portal for troubleshooting, repairs, and help articles.
- [Accessibility](https://www.apple.com/accessibility/): Accessibility features and assistive technologies across Apple hardware and software.
- [Environment](https://www.apple.com/environment/): Apple’s environmental goals, materials, recycling, and carbon reduction initiatives.
- [Privacy](https://www.apple.com/privacy/): Apple’s privacy principles, product protections, and data handling information.

## iPhone
- [iPhone](https://www.apple.com/iphone/): iPhone lineup overview, model comparisons, features, and buying options.
- [iPhone 16 Pro](https://www.apple.com/iphone-16-pro/): Flagship iPhone Pro overview with performance, camera, and design details.
- [iPhone 16](https://www.apple.com/iphone-16/): Standard iPhone model overview with key features and capabilities.
- [Compare iPhone](https://www.apple.com/iphone/compare/): Side-by-side comparison of current iPhone models and specifications.
- [Switch to iPhone](https://www.apple.com/iphone/switch/): Migration guidance and reasons to move from another phone.
- [Shop iPhone](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_iphone): Apple Store entry point for buying an iPhone.

## Mac
- [Mac](https://www.apple.com/mac/): Mac lineup overview including notebooks, desktops, and platform features.
- [MacBook Air](https://www.apple.com/macbook-air/): Lightweight Mac notebook overview with performance and battery life details.
- [MacBook Pro](https://www.apple.com/macbook-pro/): Professional Mac notebook overview for advanced workflows and performance.
- [iMac](https://www.apple.com/imac/): All-in-one desktop overview with display, performance, and design information.
- [Mac mini](https://www.apple.com/mac-mini/): Compact desktop Mac overview for flexible setups and workflows.
- [Mac Studio](https://www.apple.com/mac-studio/): High-performance desktop Mac for demanding creative and technical work.
- [Mac Pro](https://www.apple.com/mac-pro/): Expandable professional desktop Mac for advanced production environments.
- [Compare Mac](https://www.apple.com/mac/compare/): Comparison tool for Mac models, specs, and configurations.

## iPad
- [iPad](https://www.apple.com/ipad/): iPad lineup overview with models, accessories, and platform capabilities.
- [iPad Pro](https://www.apple.com/ipad-pro/): Premium iPad overview focused on performance, display, and pro workflows.
- [iPad Air](https://www.apple.com/ipad-air/): Midrange iPad overview balancing power, portability, and accessory support.
- [iPad](https://www.apple.com/ipad-10.9/): Standard iPad overview for everyday tasks, learning, and entertainment.
- [iPad mini](https://www.apple.com/ipad-mini/): Compact iPad overview for portability and versatile use.
- [Compare iPad](https://www.apple.com/ipad/compare/): Side-by-side comparison of iPad models and technical specifications.
- [Shop iPad](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_ipad): Apple Store entry point for buying an iPad.

## Watch, Audio, and Wearables
- [Apple Watch](https://www.apple.com/watch/): Apple Watch lineup overview with health, fitness, and connectivity features.
- [Apple Watch Series 10](https://www.apple.com/apple-watch-series-10/): Main Apple Watch model overview with everyday health and activity features.
- [Apple Watch Ultra 2](https://www.apple.com/apple-watch-ultra-2/): Rugged Apple Watch overview for endurance, adventure, and training.
- [Apple Watch SE](https://www.apple.com/apple-watch-se/): Entry Apple Watch overview with core smartwatch and fitness features.
- [Compare Apple Watch](https://www.apple.com/watch/compare/): Comparison tool for Apple Watch models and capabilities.
- [AirPods](https://www.apple.com/airpods/): AirPods lineup overview including earbuds, over-ear models, and audio features.
- [AirPods Pro 2](https://www.apple.com/airpods-pro/): Premium in-ear AirPods overview with noise cancellation and hearing features.
- [AirPods Max](https://www.apple.com/airpods-max/): Over-ear AirPods overview with high-fidelity audio and spatial sound.

## Vision and Spatial Computing
- [Apple Vision Pro](https://www.apple.com/apple-vision-pro/): Spatial computing product overview with apps, media, and interface concepts.
- [Vision Pro Guided Tour](https://www.apple.com/apple-vision-pro/guided-tour/): Guided introduction to Vision Pro features, interaction, and experiences.
- [Vision Pro Specifications](https://www.apple.com/apple-vision-pro/specs/): Technical specifications for Apple Vision Pro hardware and display system.
- [Vision Pro Availability](https://www.apple.com/apple-vision-pro/availability/): Availability and purchase information for Apple Vision Pro.

## TV, Home, and Entertainment
- [TV & Home](https://www.apple.com/tv-home/): Apple TV, HomePod, and smart home ecosystem overview.
- [Apple TV 4K](https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-4k/): Streaming device overview with tvOS, apps, and home hub features.
- [HomePod](https://www.apple.com/homepod-2nd-generation/): Smart speaker overview with Siri, room-filling audio, and home automation.
- [HomePod mini](https://www.apple.com/homepod-mini/): Compact smart speaker overview for music, Siri, and smart home control.
- [Entertainment](https://www.apple.com/entertainment/): Apple entertainment services hub including music, video, games, and fitness.
- [Apple TV+](https://tv.apple.com/): Apple’s streaming service for original series, films, and live sports.
- [Apple Music](https://www.apple.com/apple-music/): Music streaming service overview with catalog, discovery, and listening features.
- [Apple Arcade](https://www.apple.com/apple-arcade/): Game subscription service overview for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV.

## Shopping and Accessories
- [Accessories](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_accessories): Shop accessories for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Watch, and more.
- [Shop Mac](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_mac): Apple Store entry point for configuring and buying a Mac.
- [Shop Apple Watch](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_watch): Apple Store entry point for buying Apple Watch models and bands.
- [Shop AirPods](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_airpods): Apple Store entry point for buying AirPods and related audio products.
- [Shop Apple TV 4K](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_tv/apple_tv_4k): Apple Store entry point for buying Apple TV 4K.
- [Trade In](https://www.apple.com/shop/trade-in): Trade-in program for credit toward new Apple products.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.apple.com/shop/gift-cards): Apple Gift Cards for products, accessories, apps, and services.

## Support and Service
- [Apple Support](https://support.apple.com/): Main support portal for devices, services, repairs, and account help.
- [iPhone Support](https://support.apple.com/iphone): Help articles and service options for iPhone.
- [Mac Support](https://support.apple.com/mac): Help articles and service options for Mac.
- [iPad Support](https://support.apple.com/ipad): Help articles and service options for iPad.
- [Watch Support](https://support.apple.com/watch): Help articles and service options for Apple Watch.
- [AirPods Support](https://support.apple.com/airpods): Help articles and troubleshooting for AirPods and charging cases.
- [Apple Vision Pro Support](https://support.apple.com/apple-vision-pro): Help articles and service information for Apple Vision Pro.
- [Apple ID Support](https://support.apple.com/apple-id): Account, sign-in, security, and identity management help.

## Developer Resources
- [Apple Developer](https://developer.apple.com/): Developer portal for Apple platforms, tools, documentation, and distribution.
- [Documentation](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/): API documentation for Apple frameworks, languages, and platform technologies.
- [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/xcode/): Xcode IDE overview, releases, and development tooling for Apple platforms.
- [Swift](https://developer.apple.com/swift/): Swift language resources, downloads, and ecosystem information.
- [Design](https://developer.apple.com/design/): Design guidance, human interface resources, and platform design materials.
- [Distribute](https://developer.apple.com/distribute/): App distribution guidance for the App Store and alternative channels.
- [Support and Contact](https://developer.apple.com/support/): Developer support resources, technical help, and program assistance.

## News and Corporate
- [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/): Official press releases, announcements, and corporate news from Apple.
- [Leadership](https://www.apple.com/leadership/): Profiles of Apple’s executive leadership team.
- [Values](https://www.apple.com/values/): Apple’s values across accessibility, education, privacy, and inclusion.
- [Education](https://www.apple.com/education/): Apple products, programs, and pricing for education customers.
- [Business](https://www.apple.com/business/): Apple solutions, deployment, and support for business customers.
- [Retail](https://www.apple.com/retail/): Apple Retail information including stores, services, and Today at Apple.
